# Design List

Design Collection family of eleven data-driven lists (avatar rows, files, checklist, leaderboard, contacts, settings, notifications, inbox, metric rows, compact, pills). Follows the native Universal Theme Content Row and Media List pattern: one query row per list row, with avatar or icon, title, subtitle, meta text and an optional link.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_DESIGN_LIST` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/designList` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

Each query row is one list row. Pick a Style for the whole region, then map Title (required) and the columns the style uses: Subtitle, Meta, Image URL or Initials (avatar), Icon, Value and Maximum (bars in leaderboard and metricRows), State and State Label, Link URL. Format numbers and dates in SQL.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`avatarRows`, `fileRows`, `checklist`, `leaderboard`, `contacts`, `settings`, `notifications`, `inbox`, `metricRows`, `compact`, `pills`) | yes | `avatarRows` | Design of the list. avatarRows: people rows with avatar and meta. fileRows: documents with a file-type tile. checklist: tasks with a check box and a Done or Open label. leaderboard: ranked rows with rank number and score bar. contacts: grid of people with presence. settings: grouped inset rows with icon tiles, value and chevron. notifications: tinted rows with state icon. inbox: message rows with sender, preview and time. metricRows: label, value and bar. compact: dense single-line rows. pills: wrapping chips. |
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Main text of the row, for example a customer name, a file name or a task. |
| `subtitle` | Subtitle | sessionStateValue |  |  | Secondary text, for example a role, file size or message preview. The Inbox style shows it on one line. |
| `meta` | Meta | sessionStateValue |  |  | Short text at the end of the row, already formatted in SQL: a time, an amount, a score or a count. |
| `imageUrl` | Image URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Avatar image URL. Must be developer-controlled, for example a URL built with apex_util.get_blob_file_src. Takes precedence over Initials and Icon. |
| `initials` | Initials | sessionStateValue |  |  | One or two letters shown in the avatar circle when there is no Image URL, for example MC. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class shown when there is no Image URL or Initials, for example fa-file-pdf-o or fa-bell. |
| `value` | Value | sessionStateValue |  |  | Plain number, without formatting, drawn as a bar in the Leaderboard and Metric rows styles, for example 72. Show the formatted value with Meta. |
| `valueMax` | Maximum | sessionStateValue |  |  | Plain number for a full bar. Defaults to 100. For a leaderboard return the top score, for example max score over the whole query. |
| `state` | State | sessionStateValue |  |  | One of success, warning, danger, info or neutral; colors the status dot, icon tile or bar and is also given as text. In the Checklist style return done for a completed task (success also counts as done) and anything else for an open task. Unknown values render as neutral. |
| `stateLabel` | State Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Visible text for the state, for example Online, Overdue, Unread or Shared. Without it, screen readers get a generic word for the state, and the Checklist style shows Done or Open. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target for the whole row, for example apex_page.get_url(p_page => 10, p_items => 'P10_ID', p_values => id). Must be developer-controlled. The Title becomes the link text. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/design-list/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_design_list.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
